evals.prompt: Stwórz diagram ArchiMate dla systemu DRS (Deposit Return System) pokazujący: użytkownik zwraca butelkę w automacie, automat komunikuje się z systemem centralnym, system centralny weryfikuje kaucję i zwraca pieniądze na konto użytkownika. Pokaż warstwy Business, Application i Technology.
evals.expected_output: A .puml file with Business layer (Business_Actor for consumer, Business_Process for return/verify/payback), Application layer (Application_Component for RVM system, central DRS, payment system, Application_Service), Technology layer (Technology_Node for RVM machine, DRS server, payment gateway, Technology_CommunicationNetwork). Correct cross-layer relations (Rel_Serving, Rel_Realization, Rel_Triggering). File saved to /mnt/user-data/outputs/. Rendered SVG/PNG. Brief architectural explanation.

assertions.name: has_business_actor
assertions.description: Uses Business_Actor macro for the consumer/user

assertions.name: has_three_boundaries
assertions.description: Has at least 3 Boundary blocks for the three layers

assertions.name: has_application_component
assertions.description: Uses Application_Component for at least one application system

assertions.name: has_typed_relations
assertions.description: Uses typed ArchiMate relations (not generic arrows)

assertions.name: renders_successfully
assertions.description: plantuml command exits with code 0 and produces an output file

assertions.name: no_c4_include
assertions.description: Does not incorrectly include C4 library instead of ArchiMate

evals.prompt: Create an ArchiMate motivation diagram for an e-commerce platform migration project. Show the key stakeholders (CTO, Head of Operations, Compliance Officer), their drivers, business goals, and requirements. The main drivers are: system performance issues, upcoming GDPR audit, and market expansion. Goals include: 99.9% uptime, GDPR compliance by Q3, and entering 3 new markets.
evals.expected_output: A .puml file with Motivation layer elements: Motivation_Stakeholder for CTO/Head of Ops/Compliance Officer, Motivation_Driver for performance/GDPR/expansion, Motivation_Goal for uptime/compliance/markets, Motivation_Requirement for specific requirements. Appropriate Rel_Association and Rel_Influence relations. No cross-layer structural relations (this is a motivation-only diagram). File saved and rendered.

assertions.name: has_influence_or_association
assertions.description: Uses Rel_Influence or Rel_Association for motivation connections

evals.prompt: Narysuj diagram wdrożeniowy (deployment view) dla aplikacji webowej składającej się z: frontendu React (SPA) serwowanego przez Nginx, backendu Spring Boot na JVM, bazy danych PostgreSQL, i cache Redis. Wszystko działa na dwóch serwerach fizycznych w centrum danych. Pokaż warstwę Technology z artefaktami i oprogramowaniem systemowym.
evals.expected_output: A .puml file focused on Technology layer: Technology_Node for physical servers, Technology_SystemSoftware for Nginx/JVM/PostgreSQL/Redis, Technology_Artifact for the deployable artifacts (frontend bundle, spring-boot jar), Technology_Device optionally. Application_Component elements for React SPA and Spring Boot app realized by artifacts. Rel_Composition for node→software, Rel_Serving for software→artifact relationships. File rendered to output.

assertions.name: uses_system_software
assertions.description: Uses Technology_SystemSoftware for middleware (Nginx, JVM, etc.)

assertions.name: uses_realization_or_composition
assertions.description: Uses structural relations appropriate for deployment
